thread.title: U.S. Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.39%

author: Investing.com
title: U.S. Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.39%
text:
© Reuters. U.S. shares higher at close of trade; Dow Jones Industrial Average up 0.39% Investing.com – U.S. Oil & Gas , Technology and Industrials NYSE, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 0.39%, while the S&P 500 index gained 0.41%, and the NASDAQ Composite index gained 0.87%.
 Dow Jones Industrial Average were Apple Inc (NASDAQ: AAPL ), which rose 1.70% or 2.56 points to trade at 153.31 at the close. Microsoft Corporation (NASDAQ: MSFT ) added 1.43% or 1.47 points to end at 104.27 and Chevron Corp (NYSE: CVX ) was up 1.34% or 1.50 points to 113.27 in late trade.
Biggest losers included Coca-Cola Company (NYSE: KO ), which lost 1.92% or 0.91 points to trade at 46.57 in late trade. Procter & Gamble Company (NYSE: PG ) declined 1.63% or 1.51 points to end at 90.95 and Verizon Communications Inc (NYSE: VZ ) shed 1.26% or 0.73 points to 57.05.
The top performers on the S&P 500 were Chesapeake Energy Corporation (NYSE: CHK ) which rose 12.65% to 2.760, Lennar Corporation (NYSE: LEN ) which was up 7.93% to settle at 46.29 and Intuitive Surgical Inc (NASDAQ: ISRG ) which gained 7.06% to close at 517.11.
The worst performers were Constellation Brands Inc Class A (NYSE: STZ ) which was down 12.42% to 150.94 in late trade, Digital Realty Trust Inc (NYSE: DLR ) which lost 5.13% to settle at 101.83 and Estee Lauder Companies Inc (NYSE: EL ) which was down 3.69% to 127.83 at the close.
The top performers on the NASDAQ Composite were Organogenesis Holdings Inc (NASDAQ: ORGO ) which rose 512.72% to 82.350, Phunware Inc (NASDAQ: PHUN ) which was up 157.31% to settle at 220.00 and Wins Finance Holdings Inc (NASDAQ: WINS ) which gained 140.78% to close at 52.25.
The worst performers were Smart Global Holdings Inc (NASDAQ: SGH ) which was down 25.04% to 23.92 in late trade, Microbot Medical Inc (NASDAQ: MBOT ) which lost 16.25% to settle at 2.3200 and CLPS Inc (NASDAQ: CLPS ) which was down 15.75% to 5.35 at the close.
Advancing stocks outnumbered falling ones by 2089 to 964 and 99 ended unchanged; on the Nasdaq Stock Exchange, 1664 rose and 967 declined, while 80 ended unchanged on the New York Stock Exchange.
The CBOE Volatility Index , which measures the implied volatility of S&P 500 options, was down 2.39% to 19.98 a new 1-month low.

EUR/USD was up 0.93% to 1.1546, while USD/JPY fell 0.65% to 108.03.
The US Dollar Index Futures was down 0.78% at 94.730.
